line: पीतः क्रुद्धेन तातश्चरणतलहतो वल्लभो येन रोषा\
suggest: पीतः क्रुद्धेन तातश्चरणतलहतो वल्लभो येन रोषा-
why: Trailing backslash is leftover markup; the word continues as रोषाद् on the next line, so a hyphen (as in नगा-) belongs here.
Sister pada कुदारदारैश्च कुतो गृहे रतिः is 12-syllable Vamshastha; dropping the doubled शिष्य gives exactly that pattern.
शाशि is not a word; रविशशिग्रहणं (sun and moon eclipse) with short श restores the Vasantatilaka pattern.

suggest: दरिद्रता धीरतया विराजते कुवस्त्रता शुभ्रतया विराजते
why: Two 12-syllable padas run together without the space; the next line separates विराजते and कुरूपता.
नाथं does not construe with मधु ... रहितं ... संचितं; a word like नष्टं would, but the metre allows both.

line: इत्थं ये पुरुषा कलासु कुशलास्तेष्वेव लोकस्थितिः ॥
suggest: इत्थं ये पुरुषाः कलासु कुशलास्तेष्वेव लोकस्थितिः ॥
why: पुरुषा before कलासु lacks the visarga expected for the nominative plural; could be a dropped letter or the edition's spelling.
अतिमभीरता is no word; अतिगभीरता (deep-mindedness) fits sense and the Shardulavikridita pattern; म for ग is a typing slip.
Sardulavikridita scans; the Daitya's name is usually बलि, वलि may be a va/ba slip or the edition's style.

line: पीतः क्रुद्धेन तातश्चरणतलहतो वल्लभो येन रोषा\
suggest: पीतः क्रुद्धेन तातश्चरणतलहतो वल्लभो येन रोषा-
why: Sragdhara scans, but the trailing backslash is leftover markup; the edition marks a word split across lines with a hyphen (रोषा-द्).
युगल is neuter and is the subject of the neuter participle नालिंगितं, so the nominative must be युगलं; युगला is ungrammatical (metre unaffected).

line: यदि रामा यदि च रमा यदि तनयो विनयगुणोपेतः ।
why: Arya first half: this line has 28 matras where 30 are needed (second half is a regular 27), but the two-matra gap cannot be placed from the line itself; may be the edition's reading.
Vasantatilaka verse: the line is 14 up to कर्णतालैः, and दूरीकृताः is the first word of the next line typed twice (if the edition keeps cross-line sandhi, कर्णतालैर्-).
Vasantatilaka needs a laghu 6th syllable; यु before ग्म is guru, गण्डयुग (pair of temples) with single ग scans and gives the sense.
The द of कर्दम blocks retroflexion of the following न (natva rule), so the neuter plural is कर्दमानि, parallel to गर्जितानि in the next line; metre unaffected.
